blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–The Philippine sepak takraw team is assured of at least two bronze medals after securing semifinal berths in women’s doubles and men’s regu of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games at Mizuho Park Gymnasium. Team captain Abegail Sinogbuhan, Jean Marie Sucalit and Nelly Jay Salon placed second in Group B in women’s doubles with two wins against one defeat. Skipper Jason Huerte, Glindel Phori, Jom Lerry Rafael, Reynaldo Asilum Jr. and Ronsited Gabayeron also placed second in Group A after splitting their two games.
